message.content: SELECT a.id, COUNT(i.id) AS qualifying_count FROM accounts a JOIN items i ON i.account_id = a.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items bad WHERE bad.account_id = a.id AND (bad.status IS NULL OR bad.status <> 'ok')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items amt WHERE amt.account_id = a.id AND (amt.amount IS NULL OR amt.amount < threshold)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE b.account_id = a.id) GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.id. Use INNER JOIN to enforce at least one item. Explicitly check IS NULL for status and amount to handle NULLs correctly. Block exclusion relies on non-NULL account_id matching; NULL blocks are ignored. Verify threshold comparison direction and NULL handling if results seem off.
